english.title: Company fail to give notice in the Gazette of resolution for voluntary winding up
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a company]_
(B)_[an officer of a company]_

which had passed a resolution for voluntary winding up on **(..SPECIFY DATE RESOLUTION PASSED..), failed within 14 days after that date to give notice of the resolution by advertisement in the Gazette
english.legislation: Contrary to section 85 of the Insolvency Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
company defaulted in compliance with s. 85
by passing a resolution for voluntary winding up
not giving notice of the resolution
w/i 14 days after passing the resolution
by advertisement in the Gazette

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For the purposes of thissubsection the liquidator is deemed an officer of the company.
(ii) Section 431 of the Insolvency Act 1986 providesthat notwithstanding anything in section 127(1) of the Magistrates' Courts Act1980, an information relating to such an offence which is triable by amagistrates' court in England and Wales may be so tried if it is laid at anytime within 3 years after the commission of the offence and within 12 monthsafter the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the Director ofPublic Prosecutions or the Secretary of State (as the case may be) to justifythe proceedings comes to his knowledge. Summary proceedings in Scotland forsuch an offence shall not be commenced after the expiration of 3 years from thecommission of the offence.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being

(A)_[a company]_
(B)_[the officer of a company]_

which had passed a resolution for voluntary winding up on **(..SPECIFY DATE RESOLUTION PASSED..), failed within 14 days after that date to give notice of the resolution by advertisement in the Gazette.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding one-fifth ofstatutory maximum or on a second or subsequent conviction to a fine notexceeding one-fiftieth of the statutory maximum for each day on which thecontravention is continued.
